bug.actual_behavior: PipelineRunner.run only loads state when resume_from is None; with both flags the in-memory empty state is used and saved over the prior checkpoint.
evidence: Stage 2 received input path dot and pipeline_state.json was overwritten with an empty completed_stages list.
bug.expected_behavior: Explicit resume-from should load the saved state and then restart at the requested stage.
bug.impact: 这是由 skill 设计缺陷导致的真实环境问题，需要纳入后续修复闭环。
reproduction_steps: Complete search and save pipeline state.
bug.summary: combining --resume and --resume-from skips loading pipeline state and can overwrite checkpoints
bug.workaround: Use --resume without --resume-from so the runner loads state and advances from the last completed stage.
